privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
body: Online Privacy Policy URL: https://cleardaybaths.com/privacy-policy/
Our website address is: https://cleardaybaths.com/ .
To remain transparent and fully compliant with carrier guidelines, here is the clear breakdown of the information we collect:
Comment Information: When visitors leave comments on the site, we collect the data shown in the comments form, along with the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string.
Gravatar Hashes: An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service.
User Profile Data: For users that register on our website (if any), we store the personal information they provide in their user profile.
Media Uploads: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included, as visitors can download and extract this data.

Cookies: * If you leave a comment, you may opt-in to saving your name, email address, and website in cookies. When visiting our login page, a temporary cookie is set to verify if your browser accepts cookies.
When logging in, several cookies are established to save your login information and screen display choices.
If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie indicating the post ID is saved in your browser.
We use the collected data to maintain site functionality, improve user experience, and ensure security:
Spam Prevention: Visitor IP addresses and browser strings are utilized to help spam detection.
Profile Customization: After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment via the Gravatar service.
User Convenience: Cookies are utilized so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment.
Session Management: Cookies manage your account visibility, with login cookies persisting for two days (or two weeks if "Remember Me" is selected) and screen options lasting for a year.
Automated Comment Processing: Comment metadata is used so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.
We protect your data and only share it under explicit parameters:
Automated Spam Services: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
Site Administration: Website administrators can see and edit user profile information.
Account Security: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

Third-Party Platforms & Integrations: * The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/ . Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g., videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website. These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

SMS Data Protection & Non-Disclosure: Mobile phone numbers and SMS consent are used solely within Clear Day Bath Solutions' own direct business operations to contact you, including for marketing purposes where you have consented. We do not sell, rent, or share your phone number or SMS consent with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes.
If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely.
For users that register on our website (if any), we store the personal information they provide in their user profile.
Cookie Durations: * Comment-saver cookies last for one year. Temporary login cookies contain no personal data and are discarded when you close your browser.
Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.
Article edit tracking cookies expire after 1 day.
If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us.
You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.
All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username).
Mobile Messaging Privacy & Data Protection

Mobile numbers collected for text messaging purposes, and the corresponding opt-in consent, are used only within Clear Day Bath Solutions' own direct business operations. Depending on the consent you provide, we may use your number to contact you for transactional and marketing purposes related to our products and services. We do not sell, rent, or share your mobile number or opt-in consent with third parties, affiliates, or outside service providers for their own marketing or promotional purposes. Any platform we use to send messages on our behalf acts only as our service provider and is not permitted to use your information for its own purposes.
